narration: You paid off most of your credit card last month. Left a tiny balance on it. That one move just broke a rule most people never knew existed.
visual: Large credit card SVG in center with '$50 DUE' highlighted in red. The card slides in with a spring animation. A pulsing red badge reads 'JUST $50 LEFT'. Title: THE BALANCE TRAP.

narration: Credit cards come with a 25-day grace period — the window where new purchases don't accrue interest. Carry any balance over, and that window slams shut completely.
visual: A 25-cell calendar grid. Cells glow green, then turn red one by one with an X, representing the grace period disappearing. Text: GRACE PERIOD GONE. Calendar with a big red X overlay.

narration: Now every swipe you make — groceries, gas, dinner — starts accruing interest from day one. Not from the due date. Day. One. There's no buffer anymore.
visual: Shopping cart SVG with a credit card being swiped. A clock shows '0 days' with the hand jumping immediately to the 12. Dollar signs grow from the cart. Text: INTEREST STARTS NOW.

narration: At today's average rate of 28%, households that occasionally carry a balance pay an extra $3,200 a year in interest they thought they'd escaped. That's not a rounding error.
visual: Two bar charts side by side: 'WHAT YOU THINK' (small green bar, $0 extra) vs 'WHAT YOU PAY' (tall red bar animating up to $3,200). 28% APR badge pulsing. Text: $3,200 INVISIBLE.

narration: Here's the wild part — 55% of cardholders carry a balance at least once a year. Banks designed this rule knowing exactly when you'd slip. They make billions off that single moment.
visual: Bank building SVG in the center. Six person silhouettes arranged around it with money arrows flowing from them to the bank. '55%' statistic pulses. Text: DESIGNED THIS WAY.

narration: The fix is specific: pay the full statement balance every month. Not the minimum. Not 99%. The whole thing. That one habit restores your grace period and keeps $3,200 in your pocket.
visual: Calendar with a bold 'PAID IN FULL' stamp animating onto it. A wallet SVG fills with coin icons. '$3,200 SAVED' text springs up. Text: THE $3,200 FIX.
